title: VPC fundamentals
topic: Public/private subnets, IGW, NAT, SG vs NACL, bastion vs SSM, VPC endpoints
format: 10 timed scenario questions (~16 min, ~96 sec each). Answer without peeking at night-8-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×3 B×2 C×3 D×2 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: An engineer creates subnets named "public-a" and "private-b" but both route tables only have a local route for 10.0.0.0/16. Neither subnet can reach the internet. What must be added to make subnet public-a actually public?

options.A: Enable auto-assign public IPv4 addresses on the public subnet
options.B: Add 0.0.0.0/0 → Internet Gateway on public-a's route table
options.C: Attach a NAT Gateway and point private routes at that NAT
options.D: Replace the default NACL with a custom allow-all NACL set

questions.question: ECS Fargate tasks in a private subnet must pull container images from ECR without sending that traffic through a NAT Gateway. Which combination meets the requirement?

options.A: Internet Gateway route placed in the private subnet route table
options.B: Bastion host in a public subnet holding ECR pull credentials
options.C: Interface endpoints for ecr.api and ecr.dkr plus S3 gateway
options.D: Security group inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the task ENI

questions.question: A security group allows inbound HTTPS on port 443 to an EC2 instance. A custom subnet NACL allows inbound 443 but denies all ephemeral ports (1024–65535). Clients cannot complete TLS handshakes. What is the most likely cause?

options.A: NACLs are stateless — ephemeral return ports must be allowed
options.B: Security groups are stateless and need outbound rules per port
options.C: The instance requires a public IP address for HTTPS clients
options.D: Internet Gateways do not forward traffic on TCP port 443

questions.question: You deploy a NAT Gateway so Fargate tasks in private subnets can reach the internet for software updates. Where must the NAT Gateway be placed?

options.A: Private subnet with 0.0.0.0/0 routed back to the NAT itself
options.B: Any subnet — NAT is VPC-scoped like an Internet Gateway is
options.C: Private subnet with no default route to reduce exposure risk
options.D: Public subnet whose route table has 0.0.0.0/0 → IGW

questions.question: A Fargate task runs in a private subnet with outbound routing via NAT Gateway. The task security group allows no inbound rules. Can a user on the public internet initiate an SSH session to the task's private IP?

options.A: Yes — NAT forwards inbound connections to matching private IPs
options.B: No — NAT provides outbound-only internet access for private hosts
options.C: Yes — if the task execution role includes ssm:StartSession calls
options.D: Yes — after adding an Internet Gateway route to the private RT

questions.question: A data pipeline in private subnets writes large objects frequently to S3 in the same Region. NAT Gateway data-processing charges are high. What is the most cost-effective networking change for S3 traffic?

options.A: Move the tasks to a public subnet and assign public IPs
options.B: Add a second NAT Gateway in each Availability Zone
options.C: Add an S3 gateway VPC endpoint on the private route table
options.D: Replace the NAT Gateway with a Site-to-Site VPN tunnel

questions.question: Administrators need occasional shell access to EC2 instances in private subnets without exposing every instance to the internet. A small EC2 in a public subnet accepts SSH only from the corporate office IP range; private instances accept SSH only from that server's security group. What is this pattern called?

options.A: Bastion (jump) host for controlled SSH into private hosts
options.B: AWS PrivateLink endpoint service for consumer VPC access
options.C: Transit Gateway attachment for hub-and-spoke VPC routing
options.D: Client VPN concentrator terminating TLS tunnels from users

questions.question: Security wants admin shell access to private EC2 instances without opening port 22 to the internet and without managing SSH keys on a jump box. Instances already run the SSM Agent. What should you use?

options.A: NAT Gateway configured with inbound port forwarding rules
options.B: Internet Gateway plus a restrictive custom NACL on port 22
options.C: AWS Systems Manager Session Manager for agent-based shells
options.D: AWS Client VPN with full-tunnel mode for every admin laptop

questions.question: A Lambda function runs inside a VPC in private subnets and calls DynamoDB in the same Region. You want to avoid NAT Gateway charges for DynamoDB traffic. What is the best approach?

options.A: Assign an Elastic IP to each Lambda ENI in the subnet
options.B: Route 0.0.0.0/0 from Lambda subnets to an Internet Gateway
options.C: Place an Application Load Balancer in front of DynamoDB
options.D: Add a DynamoDB gateway VPC endpoint and update route tables

questions.question: Aurora PostgreSQL runs in private subnets. A Lambda function in the same VPC must connect on port 5432. Both use security groups. What is the recommended ingress rule on the Aurora security group?

options.A: Allow inbound TCP 5432 from the Lambda security group ID
options.B: Allow inbound TCP 5432 from 0.0.0.0/0 for any client
options.C: Allow inbound TCP 5432 from the entire VPC CIDR only
options.D: Omit inbound rules — Aurora initiates connections to Lambda
